What the record shows
  • 51 yearsRecognition took eleven minutes on May 14, 1948. The structure behind it took 51 years to build.
  • 37 yearsHerzl's program, the Balfour Declaration and the League of Nations Mandate all came before Hitler took power.
  • 757,182People counted by Britain's own 1922 census of Palestine — about 11% Jewish.
  • OverruledThe Secretary of State, the Pentagon and the new CIA opposed recognition in writing.
Every claim in this simulation is sourced and inline-cited. Dotted words are tap-to-define. Every citation resolves to a real, checkable document — primary sources, declassified records, named reporting. Nothing here asks for your trust. It shows its work.
